method: 2250 simulation steps per contact size, five Ghost/replay/scoring runs, 50 warm component runs. Local CPU only. Memory is tracemalloc peak, not device RAM or RSS. Empty histories for component dashboard. HTTP concurrency measured separately.

scale.note: All contacts spawn together; unchanged movement/sensor/scoring. Empty trainee decisions test worst missed-contact reconstruction. Python traced allocations are not whole-process RSS. Rendering requires browser benchmark.
